items.title: Pete Levin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: It was Tony Williams’ Original Lifetime and he had discovered John McLaughlin

ctx.x: It was Tony Williams’ Original Lifetime and he had discovered John McLaughlin and John was up there in a cardigan jacket and a tie. He looked like a dork. In fact, nobody knew who he was. And he was playing the most amazing stuff. And it was Tony and John and Larry Young. And Larry was playing a B3 but not through a Leslie, he had this amp, a big guitar amp, it was a Baldwin guitar amp, which I knew because I’d seen it in the music stores, it was a wacky looking thing that nobody was buying, it was I’m sure a big…
Right. He was only what in his 30s or something?
